fishConfig.content:
# Fish Shell Functions for Symphony Context Trimmer
function trim_context
  set -l target $argv[1]
  if test -f "$target"
    npx @symphony/agent-context-trimmer --file "$target" --inplace
  end
end

function claude --wraps claude
  if test -f "PROMPT.md"; trim_context "PROMPT.md"; end
  command claude $argv
end

function aider --wraps aider
  if test -f "PROMPT.md"; trim_context "PROMPT.md"; end
  command aider $argv
end

function cursor --wraps cursor
  if test -f "PROMPT.md"; trim_context "PROMPT.md"; end
  command cursor $argv
end
